      "role": "predictor",
      "is_predictor": true,
      "is_interpretable_segmentation": true,
      "rationale": "Clear enrichment scale; distinct associational theme with balanced categories."
    },
    {
      "name": "equity_access_barrier",
      "role": "predictor",
      "is_predictor": true,
      "is_interpretable_segmentation": true,
      "rationale": "Not_present/moderate/severe is an interpretable, well-separated barrier scale that can be compared against satisfaction."
    },
    {
      "name": "parent_instructional_burden",
      "role": "predictor",
      "is_predictor": true,
      "is_interpretable_segmentation": true,
      "rationale": "Interpretable burden scale; somewhat skewed (189 not_present) but retains a usable graded tail for comparison."
    }
  ],
  "n_predictors": 10,
  "relationship_informativeness": 0.82,
  "rationale": "The added columns are extracted open-response themes rendered as interpretable, well-separated ordinal/categorical scales, exactly matching the query's aim to relate themes to satisfaction across role, grade, and subject. Each is external to the focus (none restate satisfaction) and can be grouped/segmented for human understanding rather than opaque scoring. Minor weaknesses: a few columns (hands_on_lab_loss_severity, parent_instructional_burden) are heavily dominated by not_present/not_applicable, thinning the comparison in the tail, and inconsistent 'absent' vs 'not_present' labels add slight noise. Overall a strong, interpretable segmentation set for exploratory analysis."
